svg.title: Subscription aggregate and value objects
svg.desc: UML class diagram of the Subscription aggregate with Payment, PaymentMethod, five value objects and the immutable tariff catalogue, annotated with invariants §1 to §12.
svg.text: BC#2 · DOMAIN MODEL · ONE AGGREGATE, ONE CATALOG

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Subscription aggregate and its value objects
Only Subscription is mutable and transactional; TariffPlan / SubscriptionOffer are an append-only catalogue seeded by migration 000012.
DOMAIN INVARIANTS (§1–§12) · enforced by the aggregate, never by handler or repository
≤ 1 alive subscription and ≤ 1 active tariff per account
TariffPlan lives to period_end after cancel; admin-nullify immediate
Idempotency: Redis L2 24 h + PostgreSQL 7 days
success / failed are final; refund = separate negative Payment
suspended is not renewed; expired period = no grace
Catalogue immutable; price fixed in Subscription at purchase
Money = BIGINT kopecks; overflow checked before write
Time = DB now() UTC; period_end from PostgreSQL; webhook ±5 min
Fraud: ≤ 3 tariff changes / 24 h, ≥ 1 h between changes
